title: 2007 National Press Club event with international officials

plain: In 2007, at the National Press Club in Washington, a well-known meeting hall for journalists, a group of officials and military figures from several countries spoke in public about UFOs. The UFO investigator and filmmaker James Fox says he and the journalist Leslie Kean put the event on together, and he names Parviz Jafari, an Iranian fighter pilot, among the people tied to it. Fox tells it as someone who helped organise it, and it matters to him because it put officials from around the world on record.
